# Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(faircause)
library(xgboost)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(EValue)

set.seed(2026)
```


# Patch xgboost compatibility (helper)
```{r patch-xgb}
# xgboost >= 1.7 can return best_iteration = integer(0), causing
# "argument is of length zero" inside faircause. Patch both internal functions.

.cv_xgb_fixed <- function(df, y, weights = NULL, ...) {
  dtrain <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(df), label = y,
                                   weight = weights)
  binary <- all(y %in% c(0, 1))
  params <- if (binary) list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "logloss")
            else        list(objective = "reg:squarederror", eval_metric = "rmse")
  cv <- xgboost::xgb.cv(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 500, nfold = 5,
                          early_stopping_rounds = 10, prediction = TRUE,
                          verbose = FALSE)
  best_iter <- cv$best_iteration
  if (length(best_iter) == 0L || best_iter <= 0L) best_iter <- 50L
  xgb <- xgboost::xgb.train(params = params, data = dtrain,
                              nrounds = best_iter, verbose = FALSE)
  attr(xgb, "binary") <- binary
  xgb
}

.pred_xgb_fixed <- function(xgb, df_test, intervention = NULL, X = "X") {
  if (!is.null(intervention)) df_test[[X]] <- intervention
  dtest <- xgboost::xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(df_test))
  preds <- predict(xgb, dtest)
  if (is.matrix(preds) && ncol(preds) == 2L) preds <- preds[, 2L]
  as.vector(preds)
}

utils::assignInNamespace("cv_xgb",   .cv_xgb_fixed,   ns = "faircause")
utils::assignInNamespace("pred_xgb", .pred_xgb_fixed, ns = "faircause")
```


# Prepare data
```{r prep}
dat_anal <- copy(dat)

sofa_med <- median(dat_anal$sofa, na.rm = TRUE)
dat_anal[is.na(sofa), sofa := sofa_med]
cat("Sofa imputed:", sum(is.na(dat$sofa)), "rows → median =", sofa_med, "\n")

dat_anal[, sex_int := as.integer(sex) - 1L]

dat_anal[, age_grp := fcase(
  age >= 18 & age < 50, "18-49",
  age >= 50 & age < 70, "50-69",
  age >= 70,            "70+",
  default = NA_character_
)]
dat_anal[, age_grp := factor(age_grp, levels = c("18-49", "50-69", "70+"))]

X <- "bmi_binary"
Y <- "death"
W <- "sofa"
Z <- c("age", "sex_int", "elix_score")

cat("N:", nrow(dat_anal), "\n")
cat("Outcome rate:", round(mean(dat_anal$death), 3), "\n")
cat("BMI groups:\n");  print(table(dat_anal$bmi_binary))
cat("Age groups:\n");  print(table(dat_anal$age_grp))
```


# Helper
```{r helper}
fcb_data <- function(dt, X, Z, W = NULL, Y) {
  cols <- c(X, Z, if (!is.null(W)) W, Y)
  d <- as.data.frame(dt[, ..cols])
  d[complete.cases(d), ]
}
```


# Decomposition: TV, xDE, xIE, xSE
```{r decomp}
d   <- fcb_data(dat_anal, X, Z, W, Y)

fcb <- fairness_cookbook(data = d, X = X, Z = Z, W = W, Y = Y, x0 = 0L, x1 = 1L)

lbl <- c(tv = "TV", ctfde = "xDE", ctfie = "xIE", ctfse = "xSE")
m   <- as.data.table(fcb$measures)[measure %in% names(lbl)]
m[, label := lbl[measure]]
m[, lo    := value - 1.96 * sd]
m[, hi    := value + 1.96 * sd]
m[, pp    := sprintf("%+.2f percent  [%+.2f, %+.2f]", 100*value, 100*lo, 100*hi)]
print(m[, .(label, pp)])
```

```{r decomp-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5, fig.align="center"}
autoplot(fcb) +
  labs(
    title = "Causal decomposition of mortality difference: BMI effect",
    y     = "Mortality difference (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Total\nVariation", "Direct\nEffect",
               "Indirect\nEffect", "Spurious\nEffect"),
    name = "Pathway"
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = c("Total Variation", "Direct Effect",
               "Indirect Effect", "Spurious Effect"),
    name = "Pathway"
  )
```


# Figure 2: Confounder distributions by BMI group
```{r fig2-confounders, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.align="center"}
# Two side-by-side density panels: age and elix_score
conf_long <- melt(
  dat_anal,
  id.vars      = "bmi_binary",
  measure.vars = c("age", "elix_score"),
  variable.name = "covariate",
  value.name    = "value"
)
conf_long[, panel := c(age = "(a) Age (years)",
                        elix_score = "(b) Elixhauser Score")[covariate]]
conf_long[, bmi_label := factor(bmi_binary, levels = c(0L, 1L),

ggplot(conf_long, aes(x = value, fill = bmi_label)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +

```


# Figure 3: Age-adjusted SOFA distributions by BMI group
```{r fig3-sofa, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5, fig.align="center"}
mc_age_adjust <- function(dt, n_mc = 1e5) {
  dt  <- copy(dt)
  dt[, age_r := as.integer(round(age))]
  avs <- sort(unique(dt$age_r))

  lkp <- setNames(lapply(avs, function(a) list(
    `0` = which(dt$age_r == a & dt$bmi_binary == 0L),
    `1` = which(dt$age_r == a & dt$bmi_binary == 1L)
  )), as.character(avs))

  for (grp in c("0", "1")) {
    for (a in avs) {
      k <- as.character(a)
      if (length(lkp[[k]][[grp]]) == 0L) {
        for (ca in avs[order(abs(avs - a))][-1]) {
          if (length(lkp[[as.character(ca)]][[grp]]) > 0L) {
            lkp[[k]][[grp]] <- lkp[[as.character(ca)]][[grp]]; break
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  ag <- sample(dt$age_r, n_mc, replace = TRUE)
  rbindlist(lapply(c(0L, 1L), function(grp) {
    gs   <- as.character(grp)
    rows <- unlist(lapply(unique(ag), function(a)
      sample(lkp[[as.character(a)]][[gs]], sum(ag == a), replace = TRUE)))
    dt[rows]
  }))
}

adj_dat <- mc_age_adjust(dat_anal, n_mc = 1e5)
print(adj_dat[, .(mean_sofa = round(mean(sofa), 2),
                  median_sofa = median(sofa), n = .N), by = bmi_binary])

adj_dat[, bmi_label := factor(bmi_binary, levels = c(0L, 1L),
                               labels = c("Normal weight", "Overweight/Obese"))]

ggplot(adj_dat, aes(x = sofa, fill = bmi_label)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, colour = "black", binwidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title = "Age-adjusted SOFA score distribution by BMI group",
    x     = "SOFA score at 24 h",
    y     = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```


# Figures 4: Heterogeneity heatmaps (x-DE)
```{r subgroup}
sg_grid <- CJ(
  age_grp  = levels(dat_anal$age_grp),
  adm_type = levels(dat_anal$adm_type)
)

sg_res <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(sg_grid)), function(i) {
  ag <- sg_grid$age_grp[i]
  at <- sg_grid$adm_type[i]

  sub <- dat_anal[age_grp == ag & adm_type == at]
  d   <- fcb_data(sub, X, Z, W, Y)
  n   <- nrow(d)
  ev0 <- sum(d[[X]] == 0L & d[[Y]] == 1L)
  ev1 <- sum(d[[X]] == 1L & d[[Y]] == 1L)

  out <- data.table(age_grp = ag, adm_type = at, n = n,
                    DE = NA_real_, DE_sd = NA_real_,
                    IE = NA_real_, IE_sd = NA_real_)

  if (n < 50 || (ev0 + ev1) < 10) {
    message(sprintf("Skip %s × %s: n=%d ev0=%d ev1=%d total_ev=%d",
                    ag, at, n, ev0, ev1, ev0 + ev1))
    return(out)
  }

  f <- tryCatch(
    fairness_cookbook(data = d, X = X, Z = Z, W = W, Y = Y, x0 = 0L, x1 = 1L),
    error = function(e) { message(ag, " × ", at, ": ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  if (is.null(f)) return(out)

  out$DE    <- f$measures$value[f$measures$measure == "ctfde"]
  out$DE_sd <- f$measures$sd[f$measures$measure == "ctfde"]
  out
}))

# Factor ordering for axes
sg_res[, age_grp  := factor(age_grp,  levels = c("18-49", "50-69", "70+"))]
sg_res[, adm_type := factor(adm_type,
                              levels = c("medical", "elective_surgical",
                                         "nonelective_surgical"),
                              labels = c("Medical", "Surgical\n(Elective)",
                                         "Surgical\n(Non-elective)"))]

cat("\nSubgroup result table:\n")
print(sg_res[, .(age_grp, adm_type, n,
                  DE  = sprintf("%+.2f ± %.2f", 100*DE,  100*DE_sd))])
```

```{r plt-heatmap-fn}
plt_heatmap <- function(sg, eff, sd_col, ttl, flip_color = FALSE) {
  d <- copy(sg)
  d[, effect := get(eff)]
  d[, s      := get(sd_col)]
  d[, opa    := fcase(
    !is.na(effect) & !is.na(s) & abs(effect / s) > 2, 1.0,
    !is.na(effect) & !is.na(s) & abs(effect / s) > 1, 0.6,
    !is.na(effect),                                     0.3,
    default = 0.15
  )]
  d[, label := ifelse(
    is.na(effect) & n == 0, "no data",
    ifelse(
      is.na(effect),
      paste0("n = ", n, "\n0 deaths"),
      paste0(round(effect * 100, 1), "%\n[",
             round((effect - 1.96 * s) * 100, 1), "%, ",
             round((effect + 1.96 * s) * 100, 1), "%]")
    )
  )]

  lwr <- if (flip_color) "red"  else "blue"
  upr <- if (flip_color) "blue" else "red"

  ggplot(d, aes(x = adm_type, y = age_grp, fill = effect)) +
    geom_tile(aes(alpha = opa)) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = lwr, high = upr, mid = "white",
                         midpoint = 0,
                         na.value = "grey88",
                         name     = "Effect",
                         labels   = scales::percent) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), colour = "black", size = 3.5) +
    guides(alpha = "none") +
    ggtitle(ttl) +
    xlab("Admission type") +
    ylab("Age group (years)") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text   = element_text(size = rel(1.1)),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = rel(1.1))
    )
}
```

```{r fig4-de-heatmap, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, fig.align="center"}
plt_heatmap(sg_res, "DE", "DE_sd", "Direct Effect (x-DE) Heterogeneity")
```


# Step 5a: E-value for xDE
```{r evalue}
de_row <- fcb$measures[fcb$measures$measure == "ctfde", ]
de_est <- de_row$value
de_sd  <- de_row$sd
cat(sprintf("xDE: %+.4f  95%% CI: [%+.4f, %+.4f]\n",
            de_est, de_est - 1.96*de_sd, de_est + 1.96*de_sd))

# xDE < 0: relabel so RD > 0 (normal weight as exposed, obese as reference)
p_ref <- mean(dat_anal$death[dat_anal$bmi_binary == 1L])
p_exp <- max(1e-4, min(1 - 1e-4, p_ref + (-de_est)))
n_ref <- sum(dat_anal$bmi_binary == 1L)
n_exp <- sum(dat_anal$bmi_binary == 0L)

ev <- evalues.RD(
  n11 = round(p_exp * n_exp), n10 = n_exp - round(p_exp * n_exp),
  n01 = round(p_ref * n_ref), n00 = n_ref - round(p_ref * n_ref),
  true = 0
)
cat("\nE-value (normal weight as exposed group):\n")
print(ev)
```


# Step 5b: Leave-one-out Z sensitivity
```{r loo}
set.seed(2026)
loo_specs <- list(
  full       = Z,
  drop_age   = setdiff(Z, "age"),
  drop_sex   = setdiff(Z, "sex_int"),
  drop_elix  = setdiff(Z, "elix_score")
)

loo_list <- lapply(loo_specs, function(z_now) {
  d <- fcb_data(dat_anal, X, z_now, W, Y)
  fairness_cookbook(data = d, X = X, Z = z_now, W = W, Y = Y, x0 = 0L, x1 = 1L)
})

lbl2 <- c(tv = "TV", ctfde = "xDE", ctfie = "xIE", ctfse = "xSE")
tbl  <- rbindlist(lapply(names(loo_list), function(nm) {
  m2 <- loo_list[[nm]]$measures
  m2 <- m2[m2$measure %in% names(lbl2), ]
  data.table(
    Spec    = nm,
    Measure = lbl2[m2$measure],
    Est     = sprintf("%+.2f pp", 100 * m2$value),
    CI      = sprintf("[%+.2f, %+.2f]",
                       100 * (m2$value - 1.96 * m2$sd),
                       100 * (m2$value + 1.96 * m2$sd))
  )
}))

print(tbl)
```
